hooks.command: bash -c 'C="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}"; [ -f "$C/hooks/stack-update.pin.json" ] && exit 0; R=$(jq -r .source_repo "$C/.stack-install.json" 2>/dev/null); T=$(jq -r .tier "$C/.stack-install.json" 2>/dev/null); [ -d "$R" ] || exit 0; cd "$R" && git checkout -q main && git pull -q && STACK_UPDATE_VIA_HOOK=1 ./scripts/update.sh --tier="$T" >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0'
